failure_summary.description: Agents failed to complete other requested domains or update cached results when a clarification supplied enough information or a new constraint.
Agents omitted required cache saves or nested cache retrievals instead of assigning results before use.
Agents ignored contextually supplied criteria, routed a follow-up to the wrong domain, or introduced an unsupported preference.

patch.reasoning: These patterns are already directly covered by the current rules on pending deliverables, independent domain readiness, cache follow-ups, precise criteria mapping, and result assignment and saving. Adding another version would duplicate existing guidance; the previous proposed tool-audit and follow-up replacements were also rejected.
